objectives.name: Bloodstone Chip
objectives.text: Mined from bloodstone crystals.

objectives.name: Hablion's Dignity
objectives.text: Obtained after defeating ghostly Justiciar Hablion.
objectives.action: Complete the Ghostly Justiciar Hablion event chain in the Colosseum of the Faithful and defeat Hablion while Bloodstone Fen Master is active. The Hablion event is preceded by the Zealot's Overlook spirit-exorcism event; after Hablion is defeated, the chain restarts roughly 30 minutes later on that map instance.

event_details.event: Defeat the spirit of Justiciar Hablion
event_details.pre_event: Exorcise the angered spirits haunting Zealot's Overlook
event_details.notes: The repeat delay is map-instance based rather than a fixed global schedule.

objectives.name: White Mantle Crest
objectives.text: Dropped by White Mantle in Bloodstone Fen.
objectives.action: Defeat any White Mantle foe in Bloodstone Fen to obtain the White Mantle Crest. This objective is not tied to a specific event, so work on it anywhere you can efficiently fight White Mantle on the map.

farm_options.primary: Any White Mantle foes in Bloodstone Fen
farm_options.notes: No specific event is required for collection credit.

objectives.name: Jade Core
objectives.text: Dropped by jade constructs in Bloodstone Fen.
objectives.action: Defeat jade constructs for a chance at the Jade Core. Veteran Jade Bow and Jade Armor in the Dead Lab are not tied to a specific event, so they can be a practical repeatable farm instead of waiting for champion events.

farm_options.preferred: Veteran Jade Bow and Jade Armor in the Dead Lab
farm_options.alternative: Champion Jade Bow or Champion Jade Armor in Bloodstone Fen
farm_options.notes: The Jade Core is a chance drop and is not guaranteed from each jade construct.

objectives.name: Aged Ectoplasm
objectives.text: Dropped by ghosts in Bloodstone Fen.
objectives.action: Defeat ghosts in Bloodstone Fen for a chance at Aged Ectoplasm. The Haunted Canyons night event is a useful high-density option, but the item can also drop from regular veteran ghosts around the Colosseum of the Faithful, so you do not need to wait for a specific event.

farm_options.preferred: Haunted Canyons night event for high ghost density
farm_options.alternative: Veteran ghosts around the Colosseum of the Faithful
farm_options.notes: The drop is not restricted to the event and is not guaranteed from each ghost.

objectives.name: Living Bloodstone
objectives.text: Dropped by bloodstone elementals in Bloodstone Fen.
objectives.action: Defeat Bloodstone Elementals while the Bloodstone Fen Master collection is active to obtain Living Bloodstone. You do not need to wait for a specific event, and eligible Bloodstone Elementals on maps outside Bloodstone Fen can also drop it.

farm_options.alternative: Eligible Bloodstone Elementals on other maps
farm_options.notes: The collection must be active for the collection drop.

objectives.name: Pristine Blood Ruby
objectives.text: Sold by Natto in Bloodstone Fen.
objectives.action: Buy the Pristine Blood Ruby from Natto at Pride of the Pact in Bloodstone Fen for 50 Blood Rubies and 5,000 Unbound Magic. The purchase is only available while Bloodstone Fen Master is active and is limited to one per account.

objectives.name: Strange Residue
objectives.text: Gathered from unbound magic nodes in Bloodstone Fen.
objectives.action: Collect floating Unbound Magic orbs around Bloodstone Fen for a chance at Strange Residue. The item is deposited randomly while collecting the orbs, so it may take multiple routes or passes.

access_setup.requires: Complete the "Reaper of Magic" story chapter or unlock Unbound Magic harvesting with an Ancient Mursaat Relic or Unbound Magic Gatherer.
access_setup.notes: Without the Unbound Magic harvesting unlock, floating Unbound Magic orbs cannot be collected.

objectives.name: Aerial Assault
objectives.text: Obtained by killing enemies with gliding skills in Bloodstone Fen.
objectives.action: Kill hostile enemies in Bloodstone Fen using the map's gliding skills for a chance to complete Aerial Assault. The collection credit is RNG-based rather than tied to a specific event or enemy type.

access_setup.notes: Purchase the Bloodstone Fen gliding skills from Natto using Unbound Magic and Piles of Bloodstone Dust before attempting this objective.

objectives.name: Rift Residue
objectives.text: Dropped from enemies near unstable rifts.
objectives.action: Join any unstable-rift event in the Fragmented Wastes and defeat the beasts disgorged from the rift while Bloodstone Fen Master is active. Blazing, frigid, and rumbling rifts all qualify. If you are elsewhere on the map, look for a temporary Rift Entrance in Haunted Canyons or Bloodstone Maw; entering one teleports you to a currently active rift.

events: Defeat beasts disgorged from the blazing unstable rift
Defeat beasts disgorged from the frigid unstable rift
Defeat beasts disgorged from the rumbling unstable rift
event_details.locator: Temporary Rift Entrances can appear in Haunted Canyons and Bloodstone Maw and teleport you to a currently active rift.
event_details.notes: The rifts form a continuous event series rather than a fixed global schedule.

objectives.name: Shattered Guardian Binding
objectives.text: Obtained after defeating the Unbound Guardian.
objectives.action: Complete the Bloodstone Fen Jade Construct event chain, then defeat the Legendary Unbound Guardian in the Cavern of Unseen Lights while Bloodstone Fen Master is active. The Guardian appears after the four Jade Construct events are completed and must be defeated within its 15-minute event timer; loot the Large Bloodstone Chest afterward for the guaranteed Shattered Guardian Binding.

event_details.prerequisite: Complete the four Jade Construct events
event_details.notes: The Unbound Guardian appears only after the Jade Construct event chain is completed.
